build_simplequestions_data: run the build function to download and prepare the SimpleQuestions dataset into the datapath directory
download_simplequestions_tarball: download the SimpleQuestions tar.gz file from parl.ai into the specified data directory
check_simplequestions_built: check if the SimpleQuestions dataset has already been built in the data path
remove_outdated_simplequestions: remove an older version of the SimpleQuestions dataset directory before rebuilding
mark_simplequestions_done: mark the SimpleQuestions dataset as fully built and ready for use
